author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to find out how PurpleSector combined UE5 with photogrammetry and machine vision technology to build a virtual factory for optimizing the production of Cadbury Creme Eggs.

Cadbury makes 1.5 million Creme Eggs daily—20 eggs every second, wrapped at high speed. With wrapping too fast to spot by eye, engineers need a way to ensure wrapping machines perform at 100%.

Find out how PurpleSector created a super-accurate virtual environment that replicates real-world conditions in the factory, enabling Cadbury to spot areas where efficiencies can be made in the process, ensuring consistent production volumes and perfectly wrapped Creme Eggs, every time.

Find out more about simulation in Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com/uses/simulation

title: A UE5-powered virtual factory to optimize Cadbury Creme Egg production
